_comment_name_overrides: Maps a docs folder name to the 'name' field used by the product API. Only needed when normalized matching (lowercase, alphanumerics only) fails.
_comment_exclude_folders: Docs folders that never get an ordering information table, on top of the EOL boards listed in docs/en/eol/eol-boards.rst.
_comment_antenna: Maps the Chinese antenna value returned by the API to the wording used in the docs.
_comment_status: Suffix appended to the part number. Statuses missing from this map (Mass Production) are not marked.
